# bTerminalRedirect iframe view pool
bTerminalRedirect tab keep-alive uses an iframe view pool (v-show persistent DOM) instead of Vue keep-alive.

## Description
- bTerminalRedirect tab keep-alive uses an iframe view pool with v-show to keep iframes resident in DOM
- Chosen over Vue keep-alive to preserve iframe state across tab switches

## Solution
- src/utils/innerLink.js adds isBTerminalRedirectRoute and isIframePoolRoute
- src/utils/bTerminalRedirect.js extracts fetchBTerminalIframeSrc
- src/store/modules/permission.js sets meta.bTerminalRedirect = true
- AppMain.vue, iframeToggle/index.vue, layout/index.vue, tagsView.js, InnerLink/index.vue integrate the pool

- Verified in src=无锡市区G/003.md
- Project: zhi2-web-admin (无锡市区G); source session: 47301bc4-8faf-4838-b33c-54afa184fa11; code base: none

# Account change button blank page from missing tableid
pubRegulatoryAccount/detail.vue modify() used a named route missing tableid: 'add', jumping to the root path blank page.

## Root cause
- modify() in pubRegulatoryAccount/detail.vue used named-route navigation without tableid: 'add'
- Missing param redirected to root path and rendered a blank page

## Solution
- Replaced with getRouterPathByFilePath from @/utils/ruoyi to build the 'add' path and pass accountId
- pubRegAccountChange/detail.vue getOldDetail() prefills the form from the passed accountId
- Updated permission.js, listMixins.js, ruoyi.js, autonomy/record/components/detail.vue, indemnity/project/index.vue

# Multi-value field single-dict match failure shows code
relBusinessType stores comma-separated multi-values (e.g. 1,2); original translation only matched single values, so dict lookup failed and showed raw codes.

## Root cause
- relBusinessType field stores comma-separated multi-values like '1,2'
- Original dict translation logic only did single-value exact match, failing lookup and displaying the raw code

## Solution
- VerificationReceiptDetailTable.vue uses a scoped slot with contractTypeText() splitting by comma, dict-lookup, and joining with a Japanese comma
- VerificationReceiptDetailDialog.vue contractTypeLabel() upgraded to the same multi-value split translation
- Eliminated dict loading timing risk; applied to assetsLeaseContractFiling/detail.vue, resourcesLeaseContractFiling/detail.vue, subTableMixins.js

## Verification and source
- Verified in src=无锡市区G/004.md
- Project: zhi2-web-admin (无锡市区G); source session: 65ea08fa-ce59-454d-b8a6-f105c14c87a0; code base: none

# Singleton config page no id skips mixin request
platformConfig/detail.vue route has no id, triggering mixins/form.js getDetail() id-empty check that skipped the /system/platformConfig/getInfo request, leaving the form empty.

## Root cause
- platformConfig/detail.vue route carries no id param
- mixins/form.js getDetail() validates id and skips the API call when id is empty, so getInfo never fires

## Solution
- Overrode getDetailRequiredParams() in the page methods to return {} to bypass the id-required check
- This lets the page call /system/platformConfig/getInfo normally and backfill the form
- Related files: detailMixins.js, form.js

# V0V2双token清理校验不足致登录与头异常
无锡锡山业主决策H5 中 tokenV0 与 tokenV2 双 token 清理校验不足，导致登录跳转异常与旧 token 残留。

## 问题根因
- home.vue 仅校验 tokenV0，未区分登录类型，导致 V2 登录场景校验缺失
- user.js 的 clear() 未清除 tokenV0，登出后旧 token 残留
- http.ts 在无 token 时仍发送无效的 Authorization 头

## 解决方案
- home.vue 区分登录类型，分别校验 V0+V2 或仅 V2
- user.js clear() 同时清除 token 与 tokenV0
- http.ts 仅在有 token 时才添加 Authorization 头
- login.vue 等补充 token 校验与日志

## 验证与归属
- 验证：src=无锡锡山业主决策H5/001.md
- 涉及文件：src/store/user.js、src/apiV1/index.js、src/apiV1/auth.js、src/http/http.ts、src/pages/common/login.vue、src/pages/index/home.vue、src/api/security.ts、src/pages/login/index.vue
- 所属项目：无锡锡山业主决策H5；来源会话：d1439aa9-599c-4c6a-9480-89632916160e；代码基线：none

# B 端新增表单默认填充物业管理区域
园区物管2.0 中 benefit 模块申报/备案类详情页（pubManagementOrg、pubParkingRate、pubQuarterlyDeclaration 等）新增表单自动带入物业管理区域的可复制套路。

## 问题背景
- B 端用户顶部已选好「物业管理区域」，进入新增表单应自动带入，不让用户再手动弹窗选择。
- 小区接口返回的 row.subdistrict / row.community 本身是编码，前端若用 getSubdistrictNameByCode / getCommunityNameByCode 转名称赋值，提交时街道社区字段变名称而非代码，后端对不上。

## 解决方案
- 抽 initCurrentProject()（新增模式用 store 的 currentProjectId 请求 /property/complex/{id} 取区域信息）与 applyPropertyProjectRow()（统一处理字段赋值，街道/社区直接赋接口返回编码，不做名称转换）。
- showPropertyProjectDialog() 在 B 端（isBTerminal）直接 return 不弹选择框。
- 字段转名称依赖删掉后，waitForAreaOptions（等街道社区字典加载）随之移除，减少无谓字典等待。
- 默认小区与手动选择小区两条链路必须走同一套赋值逻辑，避免提交体不一致。

## 验证与归属
- 验证：会话 2e908be5 applyPropertyProjectRow 直接赋 row.subdistrict/community 编码、去掉名称转换与 waitForAreaOptions；会话 82479c58 pubParkingRate/pubQuarterlyDeclaration 按 pubManagementOrg 模式补齐 isBTerminal + initCurrentProject + applyPropertyProjectRow + showPropertyProjectDialog 四件套。
- 涉及文件：zhi2-web-admin/src/views/benefit/pubManagementOrg/detail.vue、pubParkingRate/detail.vue、pubQuarterlyDeclaration/detail.vue、zhi2-web-admin/src/mixins/area.js；所属项目：园区物管2.0；来源会话：2e908be5-90f0-4ee1-998f-327c7c2fb67b、82479c58-f984-4f4d-8b85-c7a042ecea51；代码基线：55cd8653c / 7fe15a8cb / 8f4427ecd / f101dd464 / b2b559778。

# G端误弹B端项目选择弹窗：terminalType残留态
园区物管2.0 中 G 端登录时误弹 B 端「物业管理区域选择」弹窗，根因是 terminalType 会话级状态残留。

## 问题根因
- store 的 GetInfo 只在 B 端写入 terminalType，G 端不更新、登出也不清除
- 同会话内切换账号时内存残留 terminalType==='B'，误触发 bProjectDialog
- 误触发后 G 端用户请求 operableProjectList 返回空列表，首次登录无 currentProjectId 时弹窗无法关闭

## 解决方案
- terminalType 属「登录即重取、登出必须清」会话级状态：user.js 始终写入 terminalType、G 端登录清项目缓存、登出重置 terminalType
- layout 用 isBTerminal 严格判定（非 B 端强制关弹窗并清数据），Navbar 仅 B 端显示项目切换入口
- login/LoginForm 登录成功时重置 roles 与 terminalType 强制重新拉用户信息
- 所有按 terminalType 分叉的 B/G 逻辑都要防「上一账号残留」这一前提

## 验证与归属
- 验证：GetInfo 只在 B 端写 terminalType、登出不清除导致残留；修复覆盖五处状态重置
- 涉及文件：src/store/modules/user.js、src/layout/index.vue、src/layout/components/Navbar.vue、src/views/home/bProjectDialog.vue、src/permission.js
- 所属项目：园区物管2.0；代码基线 7fe15a8cb；来源会话 84a73d0e-bafd-4217-bef6-71383e10d880
